early_html:
Private pre-launch

You're early. Charter House isn't on the open market yet.
faq: Book a 3D virtual tour and choose your apartment with us. £3,000 then takes it off the market: £2,500 is your reservation deposit and counts towards your 20% deposit, and £500 is BRIK Studios' admin fee, part of which goes to charity.
What do I pay, and when?
£3,000 to reserve. The rest of your 20% deposit within 28 days, when contracts are exchanged. The balance on completion, expected early 2028, usually with a 75% buy-to-let mortgage plus a 5% top-up.
Can I buy with a mortgage?
Yes. Most buyers use a 75% buy-to-let mortgage, arranged in the months before completion. We can introduce you to our mortgage broker.
What are the lease and ground rent?
A 999-year lease with nil ground rent, and a 10-year build warranty.
The service charge is estimated at £2.50 per sq ft per year, about £86 a month for an average 1 bed. If we manage the letting, that's 10% of the rent. Both are already in every number in this report.
Who finds the tenant and manages it?
We do: tenant find, referencing, rent collection and day-to-day management, for 10% of the rent. You don't need to live nearby.
Can I see it before I buy?

Charter House is under construction, so we take you round our 3D model of the finished building on a video call. You're welcome to walk the site and the Underbanks with us, and St Marys Gate next door is a finished Hall & Co scheme you can see for yourself.
Early 2028. We'll keep you updated as the build progresses, and you'll get notice to complete well ahead of the date.
awards_note: Hall & Co: the award-winning restoration of Grade II-listed Bank Chambers, now ProFolk, on Stockport's Market Place.
